meaning: Catching fish at sea (sea equivalent of primary production)

meaning: Pooling & auctioning of produce; market withdrawal (doordraai) happens here
variants_to_map: Veilingen | Producentenorganisaties | Producentenorganisaties groenten en fruit | PO's
notes: A parallel marketing channel (mainly fresh fruit & veg), NOT a stage every stream passes through.
If a source lumps catching and auction, a withdrawn-at-auction figure goes here.
Many contract crops go farm->industry directly, skipping veilingen.

OUT OF SCOPE and deliberately NOT a usable value - never write this into chain_L2. Listed only so a session recognises household figures and skips them.

meaning: A figure spanning several stages but NOT the whole chain (e.g. a primary-sector total covering visserij + visveilingen + landbouw + PO's)
notes: Usable ONLY when every stage it spans is in scope. A 'retail + horeca + catering + consumenten' total is therefore NOT capturable. Never use it where a single stage fits.

meaning: A figure spanning the whole chain (aggregate; no single stage)
variants_to_map: Gemengd (ONLY if it is truly the sum of all chain parts)
notes: OUT OF SCOPE: a whole-chain total necessarily contains horeca, catering and households. This is why level_1to5 has no 1. Record such totals in log.md as skipped, never as rows.
